answer: The strongest single control I know for this is geographic diversity check across submission nodes, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. Cloning 454 keys multiplies the price 454-fold: 41768 POA locked, or 7718 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. The spiral of the design is public, the ember of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the plume of honest work is what finally pays. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
